messages:
rachel: Quick sync on reserved-pools SLA profiles. Goal: ship profile types + quota semantics this quarter. Need definition, rollout plan, and risk guardrails.
omid: High level suggestion: gold/silver/bronze mapping to burst credits, prewarm window, and autoscale sensitivity.
lee: +1. Also include a per-pool soft quota (alerts) and hard quota (rejects) distinction. Soft quota should throttle with graceful 429s and backoff headers.
jeff: For burst credits: propose a monthly allotment per pool, with carryover up to 20%, and emergency top-up option for paying tenants.
tamara: Ops note: emergency top-ups must be manual or billed; automatic top-ups can surprise cost. Recommend manual with a fast approval path.
rachel: Acceptance criteria idea: (A) gold profile keeps 99.9% requests under customer p95 target in synthetic burst replay; (B) false rejections <1% in 7d pilot; (C) cost uplift <=15% vs baseline for typical traffic.
omid: Telemetry requirements: emit `quota_remaining`, `burst_credits_used`, `prewarm_hits`, `throttle_rate`, `reject_reason`, `pool_size`. Also track `billing_estimate` for the window.
lee: Admission flow detail: when soft quota breached -> respond with 429+Retry-After and route to prewarm queue if profile allows; when hard quota breached -> reject immediately and surface billing link.
jeff: Prewarm semantics: gold gets 300s prewarm amortization, silver 60s, bronze 0s. Prewarm consumes burst credits linearly based on instances prewarmed.
tamara: Ops guardrails: enforce `max_scale_events_per_minute` and a cooldown after a scale-down for 10 minutes to avoid oscillation. Also add a quota safety switch to temporarily disable prewarm for a pool if billing_estimate > threshold.
rachel: Rollout plan: Canary (internal infra + 2 customers) 48h with simulated bursts; Pilot (opt-in customers) 14 days; GA default off but self-serve in console.
omid: Include developer API changes: new fields in PoolConfig v2: `profile`, `burst_credits_monthly`, `carryover_pct`, `prewarm_seconds`. Add migration path: old pools map to `bronze` by default.
lee: Add user-facing dashboard tiles: `credits left`, `recent prewarms`, `throttle history`, and a cost projection slider.
jeff: Billing model: track actual credits used and bill overage monthly. For pilots we will credit back overages to avoid churn.
tamara: Oncall alerts: `credits_depletion_warning` (at 20%), `rapid_prewarms` (>5 in 10m), `unexpected_throttles` (>1% overall). Attach playbook links.
rachel: Edge cases: multi-region pools should have split credit buckets or cross-region bucket with fairness rules? Suggest start with per-region buckets to keep billing straightforward.
omid: Security/legal: any overage terms must be in contract for enterprise. Priors: BetaCorp asked for guaranteed burst lanes. Map beta asks to `gold` pilot slots.
lee: Example policy YAML (draft):
```yaml
profile: gold
burst_credits_monthly: 100000
carryover_pct: 20
prewarm_seconds: 300
soft_quota: true
hard_quota_reject: true
```
jeff: Action items:
- rachel: draft SLA text for gold/silver/bronze (EOD)
- omid: spec API + migration plan (tomorrow)
- lee: admission + prewarm flow diagram + dashboard mockups (this week)
- tamara: oncall alerts & playbook stub (this week)
- jeff: billing sample calculations & pilot sponsor credits (Fri)

ops-bot: Created ticket RES-2024; canary window default 48h; rollback trigger: `unexpected_throttles > 2%`
rachel: thanks all 44d will move to async for any follow-ups.
